planets.name: Kepler-1656 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-1656 with a 31.6-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: Kepler-1656 b was found in 2018 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around Kepler-1656. Its orbit and size follow Angelo et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
